hints.title: Sliding Inversion Accounting
hints.text: When sliding a window of length k by one step, subtract inversions caused by the outgoing element and add inversions caused by the incoming element.

hints.title: Coordinate Compression
hints.text: Compress all distinct values in the array to consecutive integer ranks 1 through m.

hints.title: Fenwick Inversion Tracker
hints.text: Maintain an order statistic tree or binary indexed structure to query how many elements in the current window are smaller or larger than a target.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Fenwick tree sliding window reduces this to O(n log k).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating without window bounds takes excessive runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct window evaluation requires minimal O(k) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects knowledge of sliding window inversion updates using Fenwick tree.
